placements.title: Immediate receipt dispatch decouples client interaction from long-running extraction
placements.frame: How does non-blocking dispatch with receipt generation and cursor polling decouple agent interaction from extraction execution?
placements.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 establish the foundational architectural pattern where remember operations return an immediate receipt in seconds, allowing extraction tracking via cursor polling or piggybacked reactions without blocking the client or risking lost work.
